summary_en: Takahashi Kikaku K.K., represented by Iwao Takahashi (Chairman and 40.07% shareholder of HOB), will conduct a tender offer for all ordinary shares at 1,140 yen per share from November 9 to December 21, 2026. The company board supports the offer and recommends shareholders to tender, with the goal of taking HOB private. Delisting is scheduled for January 1, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Implementation of MBO and Recommendation to Tender in Public Offer
translation_en_brief:
On November 6, 2026, HOB Co., Ltd. announced that its board of directors has endorsed and recommended shareholders to tender their shares in a public tender offer for all ordinary shares at 1,140 yen per share. The tender offer will be conducted by Takahashi Kikaku K.K., represented by Iwao Takahashi, who serves as HOB's representative director and chairman and currently holds 305,000 shares (40.07% ownership stake). The offer runs from November 9 to December 21, 2026 (30 business days), with a minimum purchase target of 202,500 shares. Upon completion of the minimum purchase, Takahashi Kikaku's shareholding (including Takahashi's holdings under related party rules) is expected to reach 66.67%, calculated on 7,612 voting rights.

The purpose of this tender offer is to take HOB private through a management buyout (MBO). The board's endorsement resolution was adopted with the approval of all independent directors and the absence of objections from all audit committee members, following fairness procedures to address conflicts of interest. The company's shares are already scheduled to be delisted from the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market effective January 1, 2027, regardless of the outcome of this tender offer.

Takahashi Kikaku K.K. was established on October 2, 2026, specifically for the purpose of acquiring and holding HOB shares. The public offeror has no capital relationship with HOB apart from Takahashi Iwao's substantial shareholding and executive roles.
